prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science
know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science
are able to apply scientific working methods to solve problems independently and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of Applied Computer Science

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (minimum 50 percent of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: Assessment requires achieving at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally presenting the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is either a written exam or an individual oral exam. Grading is on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
